notes.title: Play Tivick'ing! Chronicles -Another Story- Now!
notes.content:
Part 1 of [b]Tivick'ing! Chronicles -Another Story-[/b] is here! Part 2 will release in early 2025, and will automatically become available to all owners of the DLC expansion.

[h3]Delve Back into the Tivick'ing World[/h3]

Players who have completed the game at least once before will now have the option to replay the game in a new game mode, "Quest B". In this alternate game mode, certain aspects of the game have been changed in order to offer a new experience. Some party members join late, bosses have been given new attacks and behaviours, item locations have been moved, and certain dungeons that were originally optional will now be mandatory to complete the game. Are you up for the challenge?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2706330/Tivicking_Chronicles_Another_Story/

To celebrate it's release, [b]Tivick'ing! Chronicles -Another Story-[/b] will be on sale for one week, until Monday, December 2 at 10 AM PST (1 PM EST).

Watch the Quest B Trailer now!

[previewyoutube=V0cqJbrchvs;full][/previewyoutube]
